title: Vintage Le Creuset Cast Iron Cocotte – Rare Floral Daisy Design – Made in France
description:
Beautiful vintage Le Creuset cast iron cocotte in an elegant soft white/cream enamel finish with a charming floral daisy motif. A rare and collectible piece, perfect for vintage kitchen lovers, French cookware collectors, or farmhouse-style decoration.
Made in France and marked “Le Creuset” underneath the lid. Heavy quality cast iron with enamel interior and original lid. The floral pattern gives it a very unique retro 70s/80s aesthetic that is becoming increasingly difficult to find.
Approximate dimensions:
• Diameter: around 29–30 cm with handles
• Height: around 11 cm without lid
Condition: good vintage condition with signs of age and use consistent with vintage cookware. Some enamel wear, marks and small chips/rust spots around the edges and lid as visible in photos. Interior remains clean and very presentable for its age.
A gorgeous authentic vintage Le Creuset piece, both decorative and functional.
